upgradePolicy: Review exact upstream commit in a PR, run installers with documented refresh options, review generated diffs, run application acceptance and agent QA before merge. Never follow an unpinned branch in CI.
revisionNote: Published immutable v2.3.1 onboarding and skill-routing patch. Canonical staged refresh updates two maintainer-history workflow templates; installed runtime/skill bytes, optional selections, manual lifecycle/polyglot, generated app QA, historical deployment evidence and the independent Snyk failure remain intact.
refreshMethod: Stage tracked application files without this application-owned provenance record (not a CLI managed-file lock); run canonical standalone installers; apply generated runtime/workflow/skill differences only; retain this lock format and update its source/version fields.

skillAdditions.method: Pinned standalone installer; dry-run followed by --skip-existing; existing skills and generated QA preserved.
skillAdditions.verification: File/source identity only; installation does not establish invocation or app-specific outcome verification.

skillRefresh.method: Canonical standalone installer in tracked-source staging; generated app QA preserved; apply only generated differences.
skillRefresh.verification: Refreshed source identity; no new local skill execution or app QA claimed.
